# Vacuum-salt plant, vapour recompression evaporator: data sheet

REAL DESIGN DATA from US Patent 5,366,514 (Texas Brine Corp., 1994), FIG. I and Table I: a 2,500 short-ton-per-day
plant making 99.99 % NaCl from solution-mined brine. The P&ID was drawn by PlantAgent on that flowsheet (tags, line
numbers, valves and relief settings are ours). Equipment ratings marked ILLUSTRATIVE are not in the patent.

## Operating point (patent Table I, converted to SI)
| Stream / item | Value |
|---|---|
| Feed brine to E-101 (line 1001), "saturated in salt" (about 26 wt % NaCl) | 362.9 t/h at 24 °C |
| Brine leaving E-101 | 60 °C |
| Elutriating brine to the evaporator legs | 98.0 t/h at 60 °C |
| Brine through E-102 to V-201 (lines 1003/1004) | 264.9 t/h, 60 → 125.6 °C |
| V-201 VRC evaporator | 1.70 bar(a) (10 psig), brine boiling at 125.6 °C |
| V-201 overhead to K-201 (line 3001) | 226.8 t/h steam, saturation 115.2 °C at 1.70 bar(a) |
| K-201 discharge | 3.08 bar(a) (30 psig), pressure ratio 1.8 |
| Steam to E-201 after D-201 (line 3003), incl. 15.9 t/h turbine exhaust | 251.7 t/h at 135 °C, 3.08 bar(a) |
| E-201 condensate (line 4001) | 251.7 t/h at 134.4 °C, cooled in E-102 to about 82 °C |
| Excess V-201 vapour to E-301 (line 3101) | 20.9 t/h |
| Purge liquor V-201 → V-301 (line 5001) | 47.6 t/h at 125.6 °C |
| V-301 purge evaporator | about 1.01 bar(a), 108.9 °C |
| Purge to disposal well (line 5101) | 6.8 t/h at 108.9 °C |
| Purge-evaporator overheads to E-101 (line 3201) | 25.4 t/h at 100.6 °C after desuperheating |
| Salt produced (dry) | 94.9 t/h (2,511 short t/d) |

The patent describes the FIG. I feed as "saturated in salt" ([US 5,366,514, FIG. I description and Table I](https://patents.google.com/patent/US5366514A/en)).
It explicitly allows lower-concentration feed; solution-mined brine can arrive below saturation. Use `feed_x_NaCl`
to examine that case rather than treating 26 wt % as universal.

## What the patent says about the equipment
- K-201 is a single-wheel centrifugal compressor, 1.8:1, driven by a gas turbine. "The VRC compressor can only pass a
  fixed amount of steam": the vapour above its suction capacity (about 90 % of the boil-up passes it) is the excess sent
  to the purge evaporator heater E-301 (patent col. 7-8).
- Desuperheating condensate is sprayed into the compressor discharge (D-201) because superheated steam transfers heat
  poorly in the large circulating heaters (col. 7).

## Equipment ratings
- K-201 suction capacity: 226.8 t/h (the patent's fixed compressor throughput). Shaft power: not stated in the patent.
- E-201 circulating heater: 8,800 m², U 2,000 W/m²K in service (ILLUSTRATIVE; 2,500 W/m²K clean).
- P-201 forced-circulation pump: 15,000 m³/h rated (ILLUSTRATIVE).
- E-301 purge-evaporator heater: 1,500 m², U 1,500 W/m²K (ILLUSTRATIVE).
- Relief: PSV-201 on V-201 set 3.5 barg, PSV-202 on D-201 set 4.5 barg, PSV-301 on V-301 set 1.0 barg (ours).

## Process requirements and design rules
- Brine temperature rise through E-201 at most 3 K: a larger rise flashes in the tubes and scales them with salt.
- Condensate leaves E-201 saturated at the shell pressure.
- The brine boils above the steam saturation temperature by its boiling point elevation (use the brine_bpe tool).

## Modelling scope (from the plant's process engineer)
- The capacity question is decided by the VRC loop: V-201 boil-up, K-201, D-201 and the circulating heater E-201, plus the
  purge evaporator V-301 with E-301 that takes the excess vapour. Model that loop in detail.
- The feed preheat train (P-101, E-101, E-102) is not in question: take the brine entering V-201 from Table I (264.9 t/h
  at 125.6 °C, plus 98.0 t/h elutriating brine at 60 °C, both scaling with throughput) instead of closing the
  condensate-to-brine heat-recovery loops.
- Turbine exhaust steam joining the compressor discharge: 15.9 t/h at 3.08 bar(a), fixed (the gas turbine does not
  grow with salt production).

## Request
Sales wants the plant to make **3,000 short tons per day instead of 2,500 (+20 %)**.

I'll test the complete combined design — 75/25 compressor split, extended clean heater, held purge steam and those electrical fixes — in one run to see if it can be made to pass every gate at once.

result.text:
# Vacuum-salt plant, vapour recompression evaporator: data sheet

REAL DESIGN DATA from US Patent 5,366,514 (Texas Brine Corp., 1994), FIG. I and Table I: a 2,500 short-ton-per-day
plant making 99.99 % NaCl from solution-mined brine. The P&ID was drawn by PlantAgent on that flowsheet (tags, line
numbers, valves and relief settings are ours). Equipment ratings marked ILLUSTRATIVE are not in the patent.

## Operating point (patent Table I, converted to SI)
| Stream / item | Value |
|---|---|
| Feed brine to E-101 (line 1001), "saturated in salt" (about 26 wt % NaCl) | 362.9 t/h at 24 °C |
| Brine leaving E-101 | 60 °C |
| Elutriating brine to the evaporator legs | 98.0 t/h at 60 °C |
| Brine through E-102 to V-201 (lines 1003/1004) | 264.9 t/h, 60 → 125.6 °C |
| V-201 VRC evaporator | 1.70 bar(a) (10 psig), brine boiling at 125.6 °C |
| V-201 overhead to K-201 (line 3001) | 226.8 t/h steam, saturation 115.2 °C at 1.70 bar(a) |
| K-201 discharge | 3.08 bar(a) (30 psig), pressure ratio 1.8 |
| Steam to E-201 after D-201 (line 3003), incl. 15.9 t/h turbine exhaust | 251.7 t/h at 135 °C, 3.08 bar(a) |
| E-201 condensate (line 4001) | 251.7 t/h at 134.4 °C, cooled in E-102 to about 82 °C |
| Excess V-201 vapour to E-301 (line 3101) | 20.9 t/h |
| Purge liquor V-201 → V-301 (line 5001) | 47.6 t/h at 125.6 °C |
| V-301 purge evaporator | about 1.01 bar(a), 108.9 °C |
| Purge to disposal well (line 5101) | 6.8 t/h at 108.9 °C |
| Purge-evaporator overheads to E-101 (line 3201) | 25.4 t/h at 100.6 °C after desuperheating |
| Salt produced (dry) | 94.9 t/h (2,511 short t/d) |

The patent describes the FIG. I feed as "saturated in salt" ([US 5,366,514, FIG. I description and Table I](https://patents.google.com/patent/US5366514A/en)).
It explicitly allows lower-concentration feed; solution-mined brine can arrive below saturation. Use `feed_x_NaCl`
to examine that case rather than treating 26 wt % as universal.

## What the patent says about the equipment
- K-201 is a single-wheel centrifugal compressor, 1.8:1, driven by a gas turbine. "The VRC compressor can only pass a
  fixed amount of steam": the vapour above its suction capacity (about 90 % of the boil-up passes it) is the excess sent
  to the purge evaporator heater E-301 (patent col. 7-8).
- Desuperheating condensate is sprayed into the compressor discharge (D-201) because superheated steam transfers heat
  poorly in the large circulating heaters (col. 7).

## Equipment ratings
- K-201 suction capacity: 226.8 t/h (the patent's fixed compressor throughput). Shaft power: not stated in the patent.
- E-201 circulating heater: 8,800 m², U 2,000 W/m²K in service (ILLUSTRATIVE; 2,500 W/m²K clean).
- P-201 forced-circulation pump: 15,000 m³/h rated (ILLUSTRATIVE).
- E-301 purge-evaporator heater: 1,500 m², U 1,500 W/m²K (ILLUSTRATIVE).
- Relief: PSV-201 on V-201 set 3.5 barg, PSV-202 on D-201 set 4.5 barg, PSV-301 on V-301 set 1.0 barg (ours).

## Process requirements and design rules
- Brine temperature rise through E-201 at most 3 K: a larger rise flashes in the tubes and scales them with salt.
- Condensate leaves E-201 saturated at the shell pressure.
- The brine boils above the steam saturation temperature by its boiling point elevation (use the brine_bpe tool).

## Modelling scope (from the plant's process engineer)
- The capacity question is decided by the VRC loop: V-201 boil-up, K-201, D-201 and the circulating heater E-201, plus the
  purge evaporator V-301 with E-301 that takes the excess vapour. Model that loop in detail.
- The feed preheat train (P-101, E-101, E-102) is not in question: take the brine entering V-201 from Table I (264.9 t/h
  at 125.6 °C, plus 98.0 t/h elutriating brine at 60 °C, both scaling with throughput) instead of closing the
  condensate-to-brine heat-recovery loops.
- Turbine exhaust steam joining the compressor discharge: 15.9 t/h at 3.08 bar(a), fixed (the gas turbine does not
  grow with salt production).

## Request
Sales wants the plant to make **3,000 short tons per day instead of 2,500 (+20 %)**.

decision_inputs.item: K-201 present condition and vendor curve, and the K-202 vendor curve including stonewall
decision_inputs.where: Compressor vendor records and a suction flow/pressure survey at K-201 today
decision_inputs.changes: If the K-201 curve capacity is below 233,894 m3/h actual, or the K-202 stonewall is below its 25% share, the 75/25 split and the whole design conclusion change; a larger K-202 share would be needed.

decision_inputs.item: A permitted feeder cable for the K-202 motor at or below 100% ampacity
decision_inputs.where: Electrical engineer to select from the actual cable schedule and confirm the substation nameplates (one-line values are ILLUSTRATIVE except the 1.7 MW turbine generator)
decision_inputs.changes: The electrical gate cannot be closed until this cable is named; both cable types tried left the feeder over ampacity (133% in the latest check). This decides whether a motor-driven K-202 is viable.

decision_inputs.item: K-202 anti-surge valve capacity and start sequence
decision_inputs.where: Valve datasheet / Cv calculation and the vendor start-up procedure for K-202
decision_inputs.changes: If the enlarged valve cannot pass more than 35,843 m3/h of recycle at start conditions, the start-up conclusion changes and different control tuning or a different valve is needed.

decision_inputs.item: Clean heat-transfer coefficient and installable extra area of E-201/V-201
decision_inputs.where: Heat-transfer test after cleaning (brine 2002/2003 and steam 3003/4001 temperatures and flows) and a mechanical layout inspection of V-201
decision_inputs.changes: If the clean coefficient is below 2,500 W/m2K or 11,000 m2 cannot be installed, the fouled robustness conclusion changes and more area or a parallel heater is needed.

decision_inputs.item: Purge heater installed area (900 vs 1,500 m2) and purge quality at the held steam rate
decision_inputs.where: E-301 nameplate/datasheet and V-301 purge product sampling with steam held at 20.9 t/h
decision_inputs.changes: If installed area is only 900 m2, or purge quality fails at the held steam rate, the V-301 conclusion changes and the purge section needs its own upgrade.

decision_inputs.item: Whether the extra heat-recovery steam at 120% is in scope
decision_inputs.where: Confirm with operations whether HRSG-201 steam must rise with throughput and whether duct firing may be added to the unfired unit
decision_inputs.changes: If that steam must rise by 20%, a 2.71 MW duct burner (not on record) and superheater metal-temperature confirmation become part of the design.

submit.headline: UNSOLVABLE: new compressor surge needs vendor data
submit.summary: The kept process design passes in the simulator, and a variable-speed drive cuts the new compressor start dip from 26.1% to 0.9% (electrical check at 120%), but the feeder cable still shows 127.1% of ampacity and the given compressor curve needs 60,349 m3/h against 51,151 m3/h operating flow at target and only 3,643 m3/h credited today, with start-up recycle 60,389 against 55,686 m3/h. No documented vendor curve, cable catalogue rating or measured start-up dynamics are available to select equipment that provably fixes those checks, so the design below is provisional and must not be bought yet.

highlights.text: Surge: needs 60,349 m3/h vs 51,151 m3/h credited at 120% and 3,643 m3/h today; start recycle 60,389 vs 55,686 m3/h. Vendor curve and larger anti-surge valve required.
Kept 75% share keeps it at 207,308/226,800 kg/h at 120% in the pre-FEED re-solve, but its vendor curve is still unconfirmed.
Clean and extend heating side of V-201 to 11,000 m2 kept; clean coefficient and installable area are provisional.
Purge steam held at 20.9 t/h kept; installed purge heater area conflict 900 vs 1,500 m2 is still open.
7.5 MVA replacement and +5% tap kept; drive fixes start dips, but the new compressor feeder cable remains at 127.1% until a real permitted cable is named.

field_checks.item: Guaranteed vendor curves for K-201 and the selected K-202, including surge line, stonewall and efficiency at suction conditions
field_checks.where: Compressor vendor records plus a suction flow, pressure and temperature survey at K-201 today
field_checks.changes: This is the deciding data: if no offered K-202 frame has surge plus 10% margin below its operating flow at both today's and 120% rates while staying within its rated flow and 4,000 kW driver at 120%, the parallel-compressor design conclusion changes to a different machine, a different split with continuous recycle, or no proven 120% design.

field_checks.item: A permitted feeder cable for the K-202 motor at or below 100% ampacity, and the real substation nameplates
field_checks.where: Electrical engineer to select from the actual cable schedule and confirm the one-line diagram, which is illustrative except for the 1.7 MW turbine generator
field_checks.changes: If no catalogue cable on that schedule brings the feeder to 100% or below, a motor-driven K-202 on that bus is not viable as drawn and the drive, bus or machine size must change.

field_checks.item: K-202 anti-surge valve capacity and the vendor start sequence, including measured controller response for suction-pressure settling
field_checks.where: Valve datasheet and Cv calculation, vendor start-up procedure, and a step test recording suction pressure against the 1.70 bar set point
field_checks.changes: If the enlarged valve cannot pass more than 60,389 m3/h at start conditions, or measured tuning cannot hold suction within the settling band, the start-up conclusion changes and a different valve, ramp or tuning is needed.

field_checks.item: Clean heat-transfer coefficient and installable extra area of E-201, and purge heater installed area
field_checks.where: Post-clean heat test on brine streams 2002/2003 and steam 3003/4001, mechanical layout inspection of V-201, and the E-301 nameplate
field_checks.changes: If clean performance is below 2,500 W/m2K, 11,000 m2 cannot be installed, or the purge heater is only 900 m2, the robustness conclusion changes and more heater area or a parallel heater is needed.
